sources.title: Codex Sinaiticus official transcription — 1 Peter 4:1–5:13, BL folio 320b
sources.claim_limit: May support exactly what Codex Sinaiticus reads in the inspected units, including the 4:14 power expansion, 4:16 ὀνόματι, omission of ἐπισκοποῦντες with retention of κατὰ θεόν at 5:2, four verbs at 5:10, στῆτε at 5:12, and the explicit ἐκκλησία in 5:13. It cannot establish the full manuscript distribution or the reconstructed Ausgangstext by itself.

sources.title: Codex Sinaiticus official transcription — 1 Peter 5:13–14 / 2 Peter opening, BL folio 321
sources.claim_limit: May support the continuation of Sinaiticus 5:13–14, including βαβυλῶνι ἐκκλησία συνεκλεκτή and the kiss-of-love ending. It is a named-witness fact, not a critical-text decision.
